h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karaikudi

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karaikudi

items.pText: Karaikudi is the main town of Chettinad, known for its grand old mansions, Athangudi tiles and the heritage hotels that now occupy some of those houses. Schools and new housing in the town also ask us for play areas. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,210 km away, and sends it to Tamil Nadu by road.

A heritage property needs a gentle approach. Old floors and courtyards should not be dug up or drilled, and a brightly coloured play tower can look out of place against carved wood and tiled verandahs. We usually suggest placing the play area in a side garden or rear courtyard, away from the main view, and using self-standing installation on any paved surface. Elsewhere in the state, we have installed a resort playground in Dindigul.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: A play area for a heritage hotel

c: Choose a spot that guests reach easily but that does not sit in front of the main facade. On an old paved or tiled courtyard, self-standing equipment rests on its own base, so nothing is drilled into the original floor. Pick a few soft colours from our roto-moulded shades, such as greens or earth tones, in place of every bright colour at once. Karaikudi is hot for most of the year, so put the play area under trees or a pergola and keep seating for parents nearby.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,210 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed without drilling into an old floor?
items.a: Yes. Self-standing installation lets the equipment rest on its own base, which suits paved or tiled courtyards. We check the surface from your photos before suggesting it.

items.q: Have you worked in Tamil Nadu?
items.a: Yes. We installed a resort playground in Dindigul. For Karaikudi we follow the same process: site photos, a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, then manufacture and installation.

items.q: Can schools in Karaikudi order from you?
items.a: Yes. Schools, housing projects and hotels can all order directly. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in Tamil Nadu.
